ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 60% of pixels in the left lobe fall in the high-intensity (white/light grey) range, while 75% of pixels in the right lobe fall in the low-intensity (black/dark grey) range.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Left lobe presents a large contiguous high-intensity region from center to tip with localized low-intensity spots near the trailing edge. Right lobe presents a large contiguous low-intensity region with a high frequency of small, isolated high-intensity pixel clusters (speckling) throughout the surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: U-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding-box depth of approximately 15% of the total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serrations present along the entire continuous boundary; peak-to-valley pixel amplitude is most pronounced at the distal tips, becoming more subtle towards the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve observed along the upper boundaries of both lobes, transitioning into a sharper convex descent towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High density of circular high-contrast white pixel clusters on the low-intensity background of the right lobe; corresponding dark circular clusters are visible on the high-intensity background of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Vertical low-intensity linear streaks detected on the lower quadrant of the left lobe, intersecting the primary pigmentation pattern.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Encrusting barnacle colonies visible at the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes, appearing as irregular, high-relief pixel clusters.
